subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: Each work item is one atomically-written, human-readable file under a git-versioned, configurable **bucket-1** path; **the file is the sole source of truth** — no database, no daemon, and no index on any decision path, so strong reads are direct file reads. A single Go core implements the work-item model and the shared readiness/triage predicates, exposed identically to the engine through the **WorkTracker port** (a consumer-side interface) and to humans through a thin CLI over the same core. This design defines that port surface **together with** its first (file) adapter and conformance kit — the RW-4 substrate bundle — because today exactly one WorkTracker medium exists and the three change together.
